platform.name: Kalam CX Academy
platform.tagline: Practical skills for the people who run customer experience.
platform.intro: Short, hands-on courses built from Kalam CX's own training: real tools, real call-center data, taught by the people who use them every day.
platform.mode: Public pilot. All courses are free. Your progress, notes and saved courses stay in this browser only.

instructors.name: Mohamed Fawzy Bayoumy
instructors.title: Workforce Management, Kalam CX
instructors.bio: Mohamed works in Workforce Management at Kalam CX and uses Excel every day for forecasting, scheduling and reporting. He teaches the way he works: straight on real exports, explaining each formula so you can rebuild it yourself.

instructors.name: Excel creators on YouTube
instructors.title: Curated, not affiliated
instructors.bio: Free lessons by well-known Excel teachers, including Leila Gharani, Kevin Stratvert, MyOnlineTrainingHub, Excel Campus, GoSkills and GCFLearnFree. Videos play from YouTube and belong to their creators. Kalam CX isn't affiliated with these channels.
